## Expression on this line

Education at Stage 1 is **pattern transmission without a learner**: the molecular substrate that replicates, the crystal that seeds the next crystal, the DNA that carries information across generations. There is no "teacher" and no "student" — there is only the physical fact that structured matter reproduces its structure. This is "education" in the most minimal sense: information is transmitted from one instantiation to the next, and the receiving instantiation takes on the form of the sending one. The cell divides and the daughter cell "knows" what the parent cell knew — not through learning but through material inheritance.

The proto-educational significance of Stage 1 is that it establishes the *infrastructure of transmission*: the physical substrate that makes it possible for information to persist across time. Without DNA's capacity for replication, there is no biological education; without crystalline lattice dynamics, there is no material learning. Stage 1 education is the *precondition* for all subsequent educational development: the fact that structured matter can transmit its structure is the ground on which all pedagogy is built.

## Integrity markers (healthy inclusion)

- **UL:** proto-coherence — the "interior" of the transmitting system that makes transmission possible; the structural integrity that is faithfully replicated.
- **UR:** replication fidelity — the physical accuracy of information transmission; the minimal "curriculum" of molecular inheritance.
- **LL:** shared substrate — the common material basis that makes transmission possible; the "medium" of proto-education.
- **LR:** transmission infrastructure — the physical law and thermodynamic conditions that enable replication.

## Pathology markers (Agape / Eros)

- **Dark addiction:** rigid replication — transmission that cannot adapt to environmental change; the "curriculum" that is reproduced exactly regardless of shifted conditions.
- **Dark allergy:** failed transmission — the breakdown of replication fidelity; information loss across generations.
- **Golden addiction:** over-reading intention into replication — treating molecular inheritance as "deliberate teaching."
- **Golden allergy:** denying that molecular inheritance is proto-educational — insisting that "real" education requires consciousness.

## Diagnostic cues (Gross / Ground R&D)

- DNA replication fidelity rates as the most basic measure of "educational" transmission quality.
- Epigenetic inheritance as proto-pedagogical adaptation (environmental information modifying transmission).
- Prion propagation as a case study in "maladaptive" proto-education (misfolded information faithfully transmitted).

## Sources, joints, open questions

- **Sources:** Mayr, *What Makes Biology Unique?* (informational inheritance); Jablonka & Lamb, *Evolution in Four Dimensions* (epigenetic, behavioral, symbolic inheritance); Deacon, *Incomplete Nature* (absential features of information).
- **Open joints:** At what point does molecular transmission become "education"? Is epigenetic inheritance proto-pedagogical?
